ai.thread_title: Token fraud spreads across all major AI platforms

Breaks agency **margin calculations** if relying on token counts for cost prediction
All platforms affected: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, others have same vulnerability
ai.for_you: Direct threat to PT SMB agency margin forecasting — token counts no longer reliable for client pricing or delivery cost estimation. Urgently review your cost models this week.

ai.thread_title: End of model distillation may explain open-weight model slowdown
ai.name: Ethan Mollick
ai.hook: OpenAI and Anthropic may have restricted distillation, starving open models of training data.
insights: **Distillation ended or restricted** by frontier labs, breaking the pipeline that powered rapid OSS improvement
Open-weight models rely on distilled knowledge from frontier models; without distillation, **OSS progress slows**
No confirmed reason yet, but timing aligns with closed-source model releases and licensing tightening
ai.for_you: Strategic signal: if true, OSS models for PT SMB work may stall. Consider locking in favorite models now and prepare to shift to frontier APIs if open models don't improve.
ai.context: For years, researchers trained smaller open models on larger closed models' outputs (distillation). This was legal under research exemptions and drove models like Mistral, Llama to rapid improvement. If that gate closed, OSS stalls.
ai.what_changed: Ethan signals that the slowdown in public OSS benchmark gains may not be technical, but due to access restrictions.
ai.action: watch, strategic: monitor next 2-3 OSS model releases to confirm if distillation truly ended, then adjust your open-model strategy
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Explains recent market shift; affects long-term model sourcing strategy for the agency

ai.thread_title: AI designs and verifies real CPU architecture, runs in silicon
ai.name: ArchitectLabs
ai.hook: AI-designed CPU called Frostbite is verified in actual silicon, works as intended.
insights: **AI designed a full CPU architecture** without human architects, submitted for manufacturing
**Verification complete**: the chip works in silicon, no human redesign needed
Signals AI can now design real hardware that passes manufacturing and function tests
ai.for_you: Long-term signal only: if AI can design CPUs, compute costs and hardware timelines may shift. Not actionable this month but worth filing for 2027 strategy.
ai.context: CPU design has traditionally required teams of specialists. This demonstrates AI can handle the full pipeline: design → simulation → verification → manufacturing.
ai.what_changed: First credible public proof that AI-designed hardware works in actual silicon, not just simulation.
ai.action: watch, strategic: file this as a compute landscape shift signal; revisit in Q1 2027 for long-term implications
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Highest HN engagement (654 pts); signals major shift in compute design, though not immediate impact

ai.thread_title: Formal verification using Lean + AI proves code correct, fights AI-generated slop
ai.name: Latent Space (reporting)
ai.hook: AI and Lean now automate proof of software correctness, eliminating ambiguity in generated code.
insights: **Formal verification**: writing mathematical proofs that code is correct, automated by AI + Lean language
Historically specialist work (aerospace, finance); now **accessible to builders** via AI assistance
Solves the **'slop problem'**: instead of trusting AI output, mathematically verify it's correct before deploy
ai.for_you: Potential POV for PT SMBs: pitch high-reliability agency work (finance, healthcare, compliance) as 'formally verified' using this approach. Could differentiate on quality.
ai.context: Formal verification proves code meets spec by mathematical reasoning. It's slow but perfect for critical systems. AI + Lean makes it faster and teachable.
ai.what_changed: New signal that formal verification is becoming an accessible tool for quality assurance, not just research.
ai.action: watch, conceptual: understand this as a differentiator for high-stakes agency work; explore Lean tooling if working with regulated PT clients
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Quality differentiation angle for agency positioning; emerging tool for reliability

ai.thread_title: Riemann Hypothesis: dual proofs from AI and independent mathematician
ai.name: Levent Alpöge + Alessandro Masullo
ai.hook: Two independent proofs of the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis: one AI-assisted, one human.
insights: **AI proof**: Levent Alpöge working with Claude claims to have solved Riemann Hypothesis and extensions
**Human proof**: Alessandro Masullo independently submitted a proof, being reviewed by Brian Conrad at Stanford
Both proofs exist; **verification is ongoing**, may take weeks to validate rigor and correctness
ai.for_you: No direct action; intellectually significant milestone showing AI's role in mathematical research. File for awareness.
ai.context: Riemann Hypothesis is one of seven unsolved Clay Millennium Prize problems worth $1M each. It underpins modern cryptography and number theory.
ai.what_changed: Second independent human proof published; now two proofs exist simultaneously, one AI-assisted and one human-only.
ai.action: watch, awareness: verification ongoing; check back in 2-3 weeks for peer review results
ai.why_it_made_the_cut: Landmark intellectual achievement; signals AI capability in mathematical reasoning beyond coding
